data.narrative:
Ethos Space is a seed-stage stealth company in Space & Aerospace founded by Brogan BamBrogan, Jeff Overbeek, and Ross Centers. The sector comprises 13 identified peers—5 public companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private entities including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs—but comparable valuation analysis faces material constraints.

Peer-median triangulation is not applicable: while 14 same-sector peers exist, none satisfy the filtering criteria of matching stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier simultaneously, yielding fewer than the three required datapoints for statistical reliability. Public-comp anchoring likewise cannot be executed; the Space & Aerospace public median trades at 26.4x sales across the 6-ticker universe, but Ethos Space's revenue is undisclosed, precluding P/S application. These methodological failures are not anomalies but reflect the structural challenge of valuing early-stage frontier hardware: stage dispersion, revenue opacity, and the absence of comparable seed-round closings in the peer set.

No triangulated valuation range is supported by the available data. Meaningful analysis would require either disclosed revenue figures, identified seed-stage comps with published valuations, or additional transaction evidence within Space & Aerospace. Current uncertainty is too broad to narrow a defensible range. Any valuation at this stage would rest primarily on qualitative assessment of team and technology rather than quantitative benchmarking.
